patch_list: Background listening
Keeps text-to-speech playing while the app is in the background or the screen is off.
Colored quotes
Adds a color picker for quotes and highlights each quote in its own color.
Custom fonts
Adds fonts from a folder you choose to the reading fonts.
Dictionary section
Adds the Dictionary section with all saved words to the main menu.
Dictionary word colors
Adds a color picker for dictionary words.
Footnote speech
Adds an option to read footnotes aloud during text-to-speech.
Library full screen
Adds the option to use full-screen mode in the library as well as while reading.
Library view modes
Adds the Full, Brief, Thumbnails and Grid views to book lists.
Page thumbnails
Adds the page thumbnails button to the reader for browsing all pages of a book.
Quotes and notes section
Adds a section to the main menu with the quotes, bookmarks and reviews from all books.
Remove nags
Removes the rate this app dialog, the promotional dialogs shown on startup and the Go to Premium buttons in the toolbar and its menu.
Skip headers and footers
Adds an option to skip headers, footers and page numbers during text-to-speech. Applies to PDF and DjVu documents.
Speech rate slider
Adds a text-to-speech speed slider from 0.1x to 4x, saved per voice.
